Subject: Request: final MAP approvals and signoff window

Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Nova is ready to lock the pilot MAP but we need one last alignment on approvals, signature timing, and a firm start date. Attached is our latest MAP (Nova_MAP_v3.xlsx) with a few minor edits to milestones and a proposed start date of Jan 10, 2027. High-level asks: 

- Confirm final approver list (we show three signers: Procurement, IT Security, Ops).
- Confirm sign order and whether Redwood needs counter-signature before our legal/finance routing.
- Provide an estimate for when Redwood will have final SOW redlines (we flagged two small points).
- Commit to a 72-hour turnaround window for signatures once the DocuSign packet is live.

We'd like a go/no-go decision and DocuSign link by Wednesday EOD PT so procurement can route and hit the Jan 10 start. If that doesn't work, propose the earliest alternate start slot.

Elaine
Elaine Morris
VP, Strategic Programs | Nova Retail
Elaine: +1 415-555-0143

Subject: Re: Request: final MAP approvals and signoff window

Thanks Elaine — appreciate the clear asks and the updated MAP. Looping in Marcus (CS/ops) and Monica (legal intake) to confirm internal sequencing. Quick replies to your bullets below: 

- Approver list: confirm we expect Procurement and IT Security on Nova's side; Redwood will need a single executive-level signer (we usually accept a PO + exec email confirmation). Can you confirm names/titles for the three signers so we can populate the signature matrix?
- Sign order: Redwood prefers to counter-sign after your legal/finance completes routing to avoid duplicate redlines. We can make an exception if your procurement requires Redwood to sign first — please call that out.
- SOW redlines: Monica will triage. Marcus, can you estimate ETA to incorporate the two flagged items and return a clean SOW?
- 72-hour turnaround: that is doable on our side for standard SOW/PO flows; if DocuSign is enabled we will prioritize within business hours. 

If we can get the DocuSign packet by Wednesday 18:00 PT we will aim to complete Redwood's route and counter-sign within 48 hours. If we need extra legal review we may need the full 72 hours.

Proposed near-term schedule (subject to your confirm):
- Wed 2026-12-22 by 18:00 PT: DocuSign packet live
- Thu 2026-12-23: Redwood internal review and counter-sign (if no major redlines)
- Fri 2027-01-08: Pre-start sync (technical onboarding calendar sent)
- Mon 2027-01-10: Target pilot start

Thanks — we'll fill the signature matrix once we have names.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Office: +1 650-555-0222
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Kimberly / Monica — quick ops/legal notes from my side: 

1) SOW redlines: I reviewed the two flagged items. Neither should block the start date; both are clarifications around data retention windows and a note about caching TTL in our Dedicated profile. I can incorporate the language into the SOW and return a redline by EOD tomorrow (2026-12-21). I will attach the redline stub to the DocuSign packet unless legal requests otherwise.

2) Signature sequence: Recommended sequence to minimize delays: 
   - Nova procurement (signer A) -> Nova exec (signer B) -> Redwood counter-sign (final).
   - If Nova requires countersignature first, we can do: Redwood sign -> Nova route, but that increases legal review time.

3) Approvals matrix: I created a quick CSV (signature_matrix.csv) with time-zone-aware windows for each signer. If Nova can confirm names, we will populate and insert the file into DocuSign tabs.

4) Canary start / rollback plan: For the Jan 10 start, propose a 72-hour soft start where we open a single team-owned model for integration testing, and hold the full feature ramp to Jan 17 pending a quick post-start review. This reduces risk and gives both teams an easy rollback window.

I'll send the redline and the signature matrix by tomorrow AM. Monica — if legal wants to push the countersign earlier, flag here and I'll adjust sequencing.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Sr. Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
